itin.title: Farewell to the Land of High Passes
itin.desc: After a final Himalayan breakfast, our driver will transfer you to the Leh Airport for your flight back home. Your Glimpses of Ladakh tour with Suzu Travels concludes here, leaving you with a heart full of memories and stunning landscapes.

itin.title: Gateway to the Himalayas
itin.desc: Start your spiritual journey with a scenic drive from Haridwar to Uttarkashi. En route, witness the mesmerizing views of the Bhagirathi River. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and visit the ancient Kashi Vishwanath Temple in the evening to seek blessings

itin.title: Divine Dip at the Holy Source
itin.desc: Early morning drive to Gangotri Dham, the source of the holy River Ganga. Take a sacred dip in the icy waters of the Bhagirathi and offer prayers at the Gangotri Temple. Spend some peaceful time in the cedar forests before returning to Uttarkashi for the night.

itin.title: Journey to the Shiva Valley
itin.desc: After breakfast, proceed towards Guptkashi or Phata, the base for your Kedarnath journey. The drive takes you through the beautiful Mandakini valley. Check into your hotel/camp and prepare your bags for the high-altitude trek the next day.

itin.title: The Abode of Lord Shiva
itin.desc: Reach Sonprayag/Gaurikund to start your 16km trek to Kedarnath Dham (or take a Helicopter from Phata). Arrive at the majestic temple by evening, witness the soul-stirring Sandhya Aarti, and overnight stay amidst the high peaks of the Kedarnath range.

itin.title: Spiritual Bliss & Descent
itin.desc: Wake up early for the Abhishek Darshan of the Jyotirlinga. After soaking in the divine energy, begin your descent back to Gaurikund. Our vehicle will pick you up and transfer you back to your hotel in Guptkashi/Phata for a much-needed rest.

itin.title: Return with Divine Blessings
itin.desc: On the final day of your Yatra, drive back to Haridwar. Pass through Rudraprayag, the holy confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers. You will be dropped at the Haridwar Railway Station/Hotel, marking the end of your sacred journey.

itin.title: Heading to the Golden City

itin.title: Farewell Rajasthan
itin.desc: After breakfast, drive to Jodhpur. Depending on your flight/train, visit the Mehrangarh Fort before your final drop-off.

itin.title: Transfer to Arrival in Ahmedabad & Transfer to Dwarka
itin.desc: Welcome to Gujarat! Upon arrival at Ahmedabad Airport or Railway Station, meet our representative and begin your spiritual journey towards the holy city of Dwarka. Enjoy a scenic drive through Gujarat before reaching your hotel. In the evening, visit the famous Dwarkadhish Temple and attend the peaceful evening Aarti (subject to timing). Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itin.title: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan & Dwarka Sightseeing
itin.desc: Visit the holy Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas, followed by Bet Dwarka and Gopi Talav. Attend the evening Aarti at Dwarkadhish Temple.

itin.title: Somnath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After breakfast, drive towards Somnath via Porbandar, the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi (optional stop). On arrival, visit the magnificent Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple, one of India's most sacred Shiva temples. In the evening, you may enjoy the famous Light & Sound Show (optional).

itin.title: Return to Ahmedabad
itin.desc: Begin the day with an early morning darshan at Somnath Temple. After breakfast, drive back to Ahmedabad and check in to your hotel. Spend the evening at leisure and prepare for the next phase of your Jyotirlinga pilgrimage.

itin.title: Journey to Nashik – Gateway to Trimbakeshwar
itin.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Ahmedabad Airport for your onward flight to Nashik (or Mumbai, followed by a road transfer to Nashik, depending on flight availability). Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax after your journey. The evening is free for leisure, or you may visit the peaceful banks of the Godavari River and explore the local market if time permits. Prepare for the sacred darshan at Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga the next morning.

itin.title: Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan & Nashik Sightseeing
itin.desc: Begin your day with breakfast before proceeding to the revered Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. After darshan, visit the holy Kushavarta Kund, believed to be the origin of the Godavari River, followed by sightseeing at Panchavati, Sita Gufa, and Kalaram Temple. Return to the hotel in the evening for a comfortable overnight stay.

itin.title: Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, depart for Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga, nestled in the scenic Sahyadri Hills. Seek blessings at this ancient temple, known for its spiritual significance and natural surroundings. After darshan, continue your journey to Pune. Check in to the hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itin.title: Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive towards Aurangabad. Visit the sacred Grishneshwar Jyotirlinga, the twelfth and one of the most revered Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. If time permits, explore the world-famous Ellora Caves, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its magnificent rock-cut architecture. Later, check in to your hotel and relax.

itin.title: Parli Vaijnath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After breakfast, proceed towards Parli Vaijnath Jyotirlinga, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. Spend time offering prayers and experiencing the peaceful atmosphere of the temple. After darshan, check in to your hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure.

itin.title: Journey to Indore
itin.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and begin your journey towards Indore by train or flight (depending on your selected travel plan). Upon arrival, transfer to the hotel and relax. The remainder of the day is free to unwind before continuing your sacred Jyotirlinga pilgrimage.

itin.title: Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, drive to the sacred Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga, beautifully situated on the banks of the holy Narmada River. Seek blessings at Omkareshwar Temple and visit the nearby Mamleshwar Temple, another revered shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva. Spend some peaceful time exploring the temple surroundings before returning to Indore for an overnight stay.

itin.title: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: Start your day early and travel to the holy city of Ujjain. Visit the famous Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, one of the most powerful Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. After darshan, explore Harsiddhi Temple, Ram Ghat, and other nearby spiritual sites. Return to Indore in the evening for a comfortable overnight stay.

itin.title: Arrival in Varanasi & Evening Ganga Aarti
itin.desc: After breakfast, transfer to Indore Airport for your flight to Varanasi. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, one of the most spiritual experiences in India. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

itin.title: Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: Begin your day with an early morning visit to the sacred Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga, one of the holiest shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva. After darshan, visit Annapurna Devi Temple and Kal Bhairav Temple, regarded as the guardian deity of Varanasi. In the evening, enjoy free time to explore the vibrant lanes and local markets before returning to the hotel.

itin.title: Baidyanath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After breakfast, proceed to Deoghar, home to the revered Baidyanath Jyotirlinga, one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas. Upon arrival, visit the temple and seek blessings. Spend some peaceful time within the temple complex before checking in to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itin.title: Journey to Hyderabad
itin.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward journey to Hyderabad (connecting flight). On arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. The remainder of the day is at leisure, allowing you to unwind before continuing your pilgrimage to Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga.

itin.title: Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, drive to Srisailam, one of the most sacred pilgrimage destinations in South India. Visit the divine Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga and seek blessings at the temple dedicated to Lord Shiva and Goddess Bhramaramba. Spend time exploring the temple complex before returning to Hyderabad in the evening.

itin.title: Arrival in Madurai
itin.desc: After breakfast, transfer to Hyderabad Airport for your flight to Madurai. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. If time permits, explore the famous Meenakshi Amman Temple and experience the rich cultural heritage of the city before an overnight stay.

itin.title: Rameshwaram Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, drive to the sacred island town of Rameshwaram. Visit the revered Ramanathaswamy Jyotirlinga, known for its magnificent temple corridors and spiritual significance. After darshan, visit Agni Theertham and enjoy views of the iconic Pamban Bridge before returning to Madurai for an overnight stay.

itin.title: Journey to the Himalayas
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, transfer to Madurai Airport for your connecting flight to Dehradun via Delhi. Upon arrival, begin a scenic drive through the Garhwal Himalayas to Guptkashi, the gateway to Kedarnath. Check in to your hotel and relax while preparing for the next day's sacred pilgrimage.

itin.title: Kedarnath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itin.desc: Begin your journey early in the morning towards Gaurikund, followed by the trek or helicopter ride to Kedarnath Temple, one of the holiest Jyotirlingas dedicated to Lord Shiva. After darshan, spend time soaking in the serene Himalayan surroundings. Overnight stay at Kedarnath (or nearby, depending on weather and helicopter availability).

itin.title: Return from Kedarnath
itin.desc: After the morning darshan (if desired), descend from Kedarnath by trek or helicopter to Gaurikund and continue to Guptkashi. Check in to your hotel and enjoy a well-deserved rest after completing the final Jyotirlinga pilgrimage.

itin.title: Departure with Divine Blessings
itin.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to Dehradun Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey. Your 12 Jyotirlinga Tour Package concludes with the blessings of Lord Shiva and unforgettable memories from one of India's most sacred pilgrimages.

itin.title: Welcome to the Land of High Passes
itin.desc: On your arrival at Leh Airport, our representative will transfer you to your hotel. Since you are starting your 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour Package, it is crucial to rest for the first day to acclimatize to the high altitude. In the evening, visit the Shanti Stupa for a stunning sunset view of the Leh valley. Bike handover and a small briefing session will happen in the evening.

itin.title: Riding Above the Clouds
itin.desc: Today, you will ride on one of the most famous roads in the world. Cross the mighty Khardung La Pass, the gateway to Nubra Valley. Reach Hunder by afternoon and enjoy a ride on the famous double-humped Bactrian camels. This is a highlight of any 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour.

itin.title: The Last Village of India
itin.desc: Explore the beautiful village of Turtuk, which was under Pakistan's control until 1971. It offers a unique culture and landscape compared to the rest of Ladakh. If you prefer a relaxed 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour, you can spend the day exploring Diskit Monastery and the local sights of Nubra.

itin.title: The Shoreline of Dreams
itin.desc: Ride along the mesmerizing Shyok River to reach the world-famous Pangong Lake. The lake is known for changing its colors from turquoise to deep blue. Spending a night in a lakeside camp is the most soulful part of this 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour Package.

itin.title: The High Mountain Crossing
itin.desc: After a breathtaking sunrise, start your ride back to Leh. You will cross the Chang La Pass, the third-highest motorable road in the world. On the way, visit the Thiksey Monastery, often called the 'Mini Potala.' This marks the final riding day of your 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour.

itin.title: Memories of a Lifetime
itin.desc: After an early breakfast, we will drop you at the Leh Airport. Your 6 Days Leh Ladakh Bike Tour Package with Suzu Travels concludes here, leaving you with memories of the most beautiful terrain on Earth.

itin.title: The Lake City Welcome
itin.desc: Arrive at Udaipur Airport/Station. Our representative will transfer you to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely walk around the old city markets or sit by the banks of Lake Pichola to enjoy the cool breeze.

itin.title: Palaces & Panoramic Boat Rides
itin.desc: Visit the magnificent City Palace, the ornate Jagdish Temple, and the beautiful fountains of Saheliyon-ki-Bari. End your day with a romantic sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola, witnessing the City Palace glow in the evening lights.

itin.title: Climb to the Hill Station
itin.desc: After breakfast, drive towards Mount Abu, the only hill station in Rajasthan. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and spend the evening at Nakki Lake. You can enjoy boating or explore the vibrant local market nearby.

itin.title: Dilwara Marvels & Sunset Points
itin.desc: Visit the world-famous Dilwara Jain Temples, known for their incredible marble carvings. Later, drive up to Guru Shikhar, the highest peak of the Aravallis. End the day watching a spectacular sunset from the famous Sunset Point.

itin.title: Farewell to the Hills
